summary: Sign in with a session cookie
description: Shoppers sign in on /app/signin with their username and password. The session is kept in an HttpOnly cookie; the account page shows who is signed in.
acceptanceCriteria: With the right username and password the shopper is signed in and the account page shows Signed in as <username>.
A wrong password is refused with Invalid username or password.
A signed-in shopper opening the account page sees Signed in as <username>.
